newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-HELMER MAKES COMEBACK AFTER OPERATION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HELMER MAKES COMEBACK AFTER OPERATION.

text.p: German international defender Thomas Helmer will make his comeback for Bayern Munich in a friendly on Wednesday after six weeks out of action following a gall bladder operation.
Helmer, a key member of Germany's Euro 96-winning team, had his gall bladder removed early last month but will play in Bayern's match against regional league side Rot-Weiss Erfurt.
The German first division resumes after its traditional winter break in mid-February.
